title: Altgard opens: two steps gone
caption: At level 10 the guide no longer asks you to use Wisdom Stones you don't have yet, or to claim Daeva Pass rewards.

title: No more Save your Enhance Stones step
caption: At level 9 the Enhancement unlocks milestone drops the Save your Enhance Stones step; that advice now lives in the Extraction tip.

title: Extraction tip matches the game
caption: The Extraction tip now matches the game's Item Extraction window and says to save Enhance Stones for the belt and the Revelation amulet while leveling.
